title: Kairos Utils Smoke Test
abstract: Verifies kairos.utils importability and IO/timer/text helpers; writes+reads a smoke artifact.

original_submission.content:
import sys, os, json, time

# Enable imports from lineage storage
sys.path.append('storage/kairos')

# Import lineage utilities
from utils.io import ensure_parent_dir, write_text, read_text
from utils.timer import now, timer
from utils.text import to_snake, short_hash

def main():
    name = to_snake("Kairos Utils Smoke")
    digest = short_hash(name + str(time.time()))
    payload = {"name": name, "ts": now(), "digest": digest}

    path = "storage/kairos/_smoke/utils_smoke.txt"
    ensure_parent_dir(path)
    write_text(path, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))

    # Read-back
    s = read_text(path)
    obj = json.loads(s)

    ok = (obj.get("digest") == digest) and os.path.exists(path)
    print("KAIROS_UTILS_SMOKE_OK" if ok else "KAIROS_UTILS_SMOKE_FAIL")
    print("path:", path, "exists:", os.path.exists(path))
    print("name:", obj.get("name"), "digest:", obj.get("digest"))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
